cells.raw_text: Time to onset (within 5 days of starting drug)
Course after withdrawal (total serum bilirubin fell by more than 50% from the peak value within 180 days)
Risk factors (none like alcohol use, pregnancy, 55 years of age or older)
Concomitant drugs (no points are given if no other medications were taken or if another agent (even a known hepatotoxin) was taken, but with an incompatible time to onset)

Non‐drug causes ruled out (0 points if only 4 or 5 causes in Group I are ruled out) Group I (viral hepatitis A, B and C, biliary obstruction, alcoholic liver disease, and ischemic hepatitis) and Group II (complications of underlying diseases or conditions)
